candidate.classification_note: identity_state describes the identity evidence only and stays IDENTITY_ONLY; the event lead is recorded separately (event_state) and does not change the identity, geometry, outlet or map status.

attestations.reading: INGEMMET A6608 devotes section 5.6 to the 'Quebrada Dos Barrios / Pablo Patrón' and names the microcuenca of the quebrada Dos Barrios (Figura 9).
SENAMHI names 'Dos Barrios' among the quebradas contiguous to the quebrada Santo Domingo.
The thesis lists 'Dos Barrios' among left-bank Rímac quebradas with flows in April 2012 (list level).

identity_basis.independence: INGEMMET A6608 (2012) is the primary source. The SENAMHI 2020 adjacency sentence reproduces the A6608 §5.5 sentence almost word for word (quote A6-P23-SANTO-DOMINGO), and the 2018 thesis cites 'Zavala et al., 2012'; neither is independent of A6608 for Dos Barrios.
identity_basis.sufficient_for: Documentary identity. Not sufficient for hydrologic distinctness, geometry or confluence; the event lead rests on A6608 alone (event_leads).

candidate.administrative_basis: Not stated for Dos Barrios by any source read. SENAMHI places the study area in the middle Rímac basin at Chosica; the neighbouring quebrada La Ronda is recorded in Lurigancho-Chosica by the national audit and in Ricardo Palma by IGP 2020 (quote IGP-P16-LA-RONDA-DISTRICT), so no district is inferred from adjacency.

documentary_location.reading: Reached from the left bank of the río Rímac (from Chosica, Puente Los Ángeles or Ricardo Palma); 'frente a Moyopampa'. Not a district statement.

A6608 §5.6 prints both Santo Domingo and La Ronda as '(al oeste)'; §5.5 (A6-P23-SANTO-DOMINGO) and §5.7 (A6-P38-LA-RONDA) place Dos Barrios east of Santo Domingo and west of La Ronda. The inconsistency is recorded, not resolved; no topology is derived.
Contiguous to the quebrada Santo Domingo; '(al este)' follows 'Dos Barrios y La Ronda' and its scope (both or only La Ronda) is not adjudicated.
Named in a list of quebradas 'de la margen izquierda del río Rímac' (list-level statement).

relations_recorded_not_adopted.note: A6608 calls Pablo Patrón a 'zona'/'sector' in the lower part of the old fan of the quebrada Dos Barrios, reached by its 5 April 2012 flow; RIIGEO 2012 names it as a settlement (asentamiento urbano, Cooperativa). The '/' in the §5.6 heading joins the channel and the affected sector, as the same report joins two barrios with '/' ('Mariscal Castilla/San Juan'). A '/' is not read as hydrologic equivalence; Pablo Patrón is not recorded as a channel name.

The audit row 'Pablo Patrón/Dos Amigos' comes from a PREDES booklet (NGO). A6608 places the Pablo Patrón sector on the Dos Barrios fan, which makes a relation plausible, but 'Dos Amigos' appears in neither A6608 nor RIIGEO 2012 and no source equates the PREDES label with the quebrada Dos Barrios. Not merged.

A6608 names Mariscal Castilla as a barrio on the old fan of the quebrada Dos Barrios; RIIGEO 2012 lists a 'quebrada' Mariscal Castilla among the left-bank quebradas and does not name Dos Barrios. Whether RIIGEO's label designates the same channel is not stated by any source. Not merged.
Adjacency stated in text only; no shared divide, confluence or catchment boundary is derived.
